title: V0.23 Matrix-to-Stream Epilogue Fusion Bridge & Closed-Loop AXI Writeback
scope: logic simulation only; no synthesis, Vivado, STA, board, VNC, push; strictly local to working directory

phases.name: Audit contracts, read primary_stream_fix/REPORT, primary_acceptance/round2, integrated/REPORT, copy candidate sources
Design & implement matrix-to-stream fusion bridge (credit-gated cache readout, FIFO capacity proof, odd tail support)
Design & implement closed-loop fused matrix cluster top with direct A16 AXI write DMA & response drain boundaries
Develop independent gold references (FMA single-rounding gold vs unfused baseline gold, odd tail vectors)
Module & cluster logic verification under 5 backpressure modes, odd tails, non-trivial scale/bias
Comparative cycle & bus traffic analysis against unfused baseline under identical workload
Deliverables: REPORT.md, INTERFACE.md, result.json, SHA256SUMS.txt, filelists, run_all.sh
